parsed.note_claim: El nuevo Lord Mayor de Leicester, Kulwinder Singh Johal, es sij y no musulmán.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Guided by his Sikh faith and the principle of seva (selfless service), he has volunteered for many years.
